title: Spawner
content:
Spawner

Handles entity spawning logic.

Component Common

Schema

JSON
{
  "spawner": {
    "entities": ["entityID1", "entityID2"],
    "spawnDelay": 0.0,
    "maxCount": 123
  }
}

Description

The Spawner component handles entity spawning logic. It manages which entities to spawn, the delay between spawns, and the maximum number of entities that can be spawned.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
entitiesstring[]Array of entity IDs to spawn.
spawnDelayfloatDelay in seconds between each spawn.
maxCountintMaximum number of entities to spawn.

Example

JSON
{
  "spawner": {
    "entities": ["enemy_goblin", "enemy_skeleton"],
    "spawnDelay": 2.5,
    "maxCount": 10
  }
}
